newsitem.title: USA: Genesee says beer and food boosted Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Genesee says beer and food boosted Q3 results.

text.p: Genesee Corp said Tuesday that higher third quarter and year to date revenues and earnings were a result of improved performance by Genesee Brewing Company and Ontario Foods.

Genesee Brewing Company recorded third quarter net sales of $29.0 million, an increase of $2.5 million from the prior year, said the company. This increase, it added, was the result of continued growth in the HighFalls craft brands, the general industry price increase that went into effect early in 1996, and increased volume under the brewing contract with Boston Beer Company.

Although sales of Genesee Brewing Company's core brands were lower in the first three quarters of fiscal 1997, sales trends improved in the third quarter, said the company. Higher sales of the HighFalls craft brands and increased contract brewing in the third quarter more than offset lower sales for the core brands.

Ontario Foods had net sales of $5.7 million in the third quarter, up from $5.2 million a year ago. Ontario Foods' private label side dishes continued to show strong growth in the third quarter. This growth, combined with higher iced tea sales, more than offset lower contract manufacturing revenues.
